arms.CONTROL_ALT: exact inherited ALT_0_2 sequential updates using the frozen source-gradient training primitive
arms.SHAM_MEASURE_ALT: same 64 source updates; before each step compute source and target gradients from the identical pre-step state, restore the exact source gradient and source-consumed RNG, apply no projection; final model/optimizer/RNG digests must exactly equal CONTROL_ALT
arms.PROJECT_CONFLICT_ALT: same measured-update machinery; when source-target gradient dot product is negative and target norm squared is above 1e-24, replace source gradient g_s with g_s-(dot(g_s,g_t)/||g_t||^2)g_t before the inherited global norm clip and AdamW step

measurement_integrity.auxiliary_target_gradient_rng_effect: restored; authoritative RNG after each measured update equals the state immediately after source forward/backward

interpretation.CONFLICT_PROJECTION_RESCUE: the exact control failure reproduces, measurement-only sham is bitwise trajectory-equivalent, at least one negative-dot projection occurs, and the projected arm simultaneously fits worlds 0 and 2; the registered conflicting gradient component is causally sufficient for rescue under this frozen court
interpretation.CONFLICT_PROJECTION_NO_RESCUE: the exact control failure reproduces, sham integrity holds and projection activates, but the projected arm still fails simultaneous fit; local orthogonal conflict removal alone is insufficient under this frozen court
interpretation.PROJECTION_NOT_TRIGGERED: the registered projection rule never activates, so the intervention court cannot support a projection-rescue or no-rescue claim
interpretation.SHAM_TRAJECTORY_MISMATCH: measurement instrumentation changes the nominal control trajectory; intervention comparison is invalid

nonclaims: EXP-330 does not establish PCGrad or any projection method as a universal optimizer improvement
EXP-330 does not establish that all multiworld interference is caused by pairwise gradient conflict
EXP-330 does not establish an architectural capacity ceiling
EXP-330 does not establish that scaling would help
EXP-330 does not authorize EXP-320 or larger model sizes
